title: Probing the Prompt KV Cache: Where It Becomes Dispensable
abstract: arXiv:2605.30574v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prior KV cache compression schemes empirically demonstrate that the prompt cache can be dropped or summarised during decoding with little accuracy loss, indicating that it is partly redundant. We ask when and what kind of redundancy, i.e., at which layers, after how many decoding steps, and in what form can the prompt span KV cache be replaced without breaking the task. A controlled splice intervention swept over layers and decoding steps shows this redundancy is about form rather than content. Replacing the upper layer prompt span KV cache with KV cache from a chat template scaffold with empty user content or filler tokens recovers near clean accuracy, while zeroing the entire prompt KV collapses accuracy. The dissociation replicates across the Qwen3, Gemma 3, and Llama 3 model families of varying sizes on multiple datasets. translated_title: 探究提示词KV缓存：它在何处变得可有可无
translated_abstract: 此前的KV缓存压缩方案已在经验上表明，在解码过程中丢弃或摘要化提示词缓存几乎不会造成精度损失，这说明提示词缓存部分是冗余的。我们进一步追问这种冗余何时出现、属于何种类型，即在哪一层、经过多少解码步骤之后，以及以何种形式替换提示词跨度的KV缓存而不会破坏任务。在层和解码步骤上进行系统性扫掠的受控拼接干预实验表明，这种冗余关乎形式而非内容：用来自空用户内容或填充token的聊天模板脚手架的KV缓存替换上层的提示词跨度KV缓存，可以恢复接近原始的精度，而将整个提示词KV置零则会导致精度崩溃。这种分离现象在Qwen3、Gemma 3和Llama 3等不同规模的模型家族以及多个数据集上均得到复现。该技术的服务化实现可将KV内存减少15.4%，并多支持18%受HBM限制的并发请求。
tldr: 本研究通过受控干预实验揭示提示词KV缓存的冗余在于形式而非内容——在深层用空内容或填充token的脚手架KV缓存替换提示词缓存即可几乎无损恢复精度，并在Qwen3、Gemma 3、Llama 3等模型上得到验证，实现中KV内存减少15.4%且多支持18%的并发请求。
en_tdlr: Through controlled splice interventions, this study reveals that prompt KV cache redundancy lies in form rather than content—replacing upper-layer prompt KV cache with scaffold KV from empty user content or filler tokens nearly restores accuracy, replicated across Qwen3, Gemma 3, and Llama 3 families, with a serving implementation reducing KV memory by 15.4% and supporting 18% more HBM-constrained requests.
